class Hungarian {
public:
    static const int SIZE = 2000;
    int cnt, pos[SIZE], rev[SIZE];
    int gao(int n, vector<int> e[]) {
        cnt = 0;
        memset(pos, -1, sizeof(pos));
        memset(rev, -1, sizeof(rev));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            memset(v, 0, sizeof(v));
            if (match(i, e)) cnt++;
        }
        return cnt;
    }

            if (!v[y]) {
                v[y] = 1;
                if (rev[y] < 0 || match(rev[y], e)) {
                    pos[x] = y;
                    rev[y] = x;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

public:

        matchCount = 0;
